# get the function to retrieve sql properties
%run Utility/getSQLConnectionString

# retrieve sql connection_string and connection_properties
jdbcUrl,conn_Prop = getSQLConnectionString()

query = "(SELECT * FROM [pfd].[MatriceCostiRecapitisti] ) as tb"
spark.read.jdbc(url=jdbcUrl, table=query, properties=conn_Prop).createOrReplaceTempView("TmpMatriceRecapitisti")
spark.read.jdbc(url=jdbcUrl, table="(SELECT * FROM [pfd].[Notifiche] WHERE notificationtype <> 'DIGITALE') as tb", properties=conn_Prop).createOrReplaceTempView("Notifiche")

spark.sql("""select
	cast(left(event_timestamp,19) as timestamp) as presaincarico_data,
	event_id, dataInizioValidita, dataFineValidita,
	paper_product_type as analogico_prodotto,
	cast(number_of_pages as int) as analogico_totale_pagine,
	CASE
		WHEN g_envelope_weight BETWEEN 1 AND 20 THEN 1
		WHEN g_envelope_weight BETWEEN 21 AND 50 THEN 21
		WHEN g_envelope_weight BETWEEN 51 AND 100 THEN 51
		WHEN g_envelope_weight BETWEEN 101 AND 250 THEN 101
		WHEN g_envelope_weight BETWEEN 251 AND 350 THEN 251
		WHEN g_envelope_weight BETWEEN 351 AND 1000 THEN 351
		WHEN g_envelope_weight BETWEEN 1001 AND 2000 THEN 1001
	END as analogico_totale_peso_gr_min,
	CASE
		WHEN paper_product_type in ('RIS', 'RIR') THEN foreign_state
		ELSE zip_code
	END as analogico_geokey
	from Notifiche
	INNER JOIN (SELECT distinct dataInizioValidita,dataFineValidita from TmpMatriceRecapitisti) c
    ON cast(left(event_timestamp,19) as timestamp) >= c.dataInizioValidita 
	AND cast(left(event_timestamp,19) as timestamp) <= c.dataFineValidita
		""").createOrReplaceTempView("joinrecap")
	#20498508

df = spark.sql("""select * from joinrecap j 
    left JOIN TmpMatriceRecapitisti r
        ON j.analogico_prodotto=r.product 
        AND (j.analogico_geokey = r.geokey OR j.analogico_geokey = r.foreign_state) 
        AND j.analogico_totale_peso_gr_min=r.min
        AND r.dataInizioValidita = j.dataInizioValidita""")
